rules.statement: In a project whose own decision records are numbered from 1000, don't ask for the `project-template ADR-NNNN` prefix on a citation of a template record numbered below 1000: the number alone identifies it as the template's record.
rules.why: The template convention asks for the prefix only in projects whose own records started below 1000; when a project's records start at 1000, a number below 1000 can only name a template record, and the link points into the project-template folder.
rules.check: Before reporting an unprefixed template ADR citation, check the decisions README for where the project's own numbering starts, and whether the link targets the project-template folder. Report only if the project's own records also use numbers below 1000.
